title: Asana Starter to self-hosted OpenProject
summary: OpenProject covers Asana's core — projects, tasks, boards, timelines — and prices per user in EUR instead of per seat per month forever.

you_lose: Asana's polish and mobile apps — OpenProject is functional, not delightful
Forms and approval flows as one-click templates
you_gain: Gantt charts and baselines that Asana charges Advanced-tier money for
GPL-3.0 with unlimited users and no seat count anywhere in the arithmetic
One place for tasks, wiki, and time tracking instead of three integrations

caveats: OpenProject is heavier to run than the SaaS it replaces — 4 GB RAM is the floor, and updates are frequent and real work.
CSV import moves tasks but not automation rules, forms, or portfolio hierarchy. Budget the 12 hours for a 15-seat team with a few years of history.
